hero.label: Made for Mount
hero.headline: I want to help Mount own the AI agent insurance category.
hero.subheadline: Mount is solving a problem that didn't exist three years ago: who is liable when an AI agent makes a costly mistake? That question is only getting louder, and Fabian and John are building the infrastructure to answer it. I want to be the person who gets that story in front of the right people before anyone else does.

whyCompany.title: The agent economy needs an insurer and Mount is the only one built for it
whyCompany.body: Existing insurers lack the data, the models, and the speed to underwrite deployed AI systems. Mount is not just selling a product, it is defining an entirely new coverage category at exactly the moment enterprises are deploying autonomous agents at scale. That timing is rare and the wedge is real.

whyCompany.title: Two founders, one engineering hire, and a GTM seat wide open
whyCompany.body: Mount is a YC 2026 company with two employees, which means the first GTM person shapes the motion from scratch: messaging, ICP, outbound, channel. There is no playbook to inherit and no bureaucracy to navigate. That is the kind of blank-canvas moment I am actively looking for at this point in my career.

whyCompany.title: I have done exactly this kind of zero-to-pipeline GTM work before
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach from nothing, built LinkedIn sequences in HubSpot, and helped close 15 to 20 paying clients as a BDR. At NextAfter I sharpened that with B2B digital strategy in a consultancy that lives and dies by measurable conversion. Mount needs someone who can generate pipeline on day one and I have done it.

quote: Insurance for AI agents sounds niche until you realize every company deploying an autonomous system is one hallucination away from a lawsuit. I want to be the person who makes sure the right buyers understand that before they find out the hard way.
